name: West Australian Networks
summary: WA-owned ISP trading as 'Westnet' on westnet.net.au — unrelated to Westnet (westnet.com.au, bought by iiNet); dialup, ISDN, ADSL2+, mobile broadband, VoIP, hosting and web design, with a focus on rural, regional and remote areas; TIO and WAIA member; acquired by EFTel (Jul 2012).

events.details: WA-owned ISP trading as 'Westnet' on westnet.net.au; earliest Wayback capture Dec 1998; company claimed to have provided Internet and IT services since 1995; acquired by EFTel Jul 2012.

refs.label: iTnews: EFTel acquires West Australian Networks (Jun 2012)

events.details: Acquired by EFTel; ~1,500 customers transferred to EFTel from 2 Jul 2012 under an all-cash deal that also included the company's IP and westnet.net.au domain.
